verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination/receipt through the same API, with per-rail capability details (RTP instant settlement, FedNow reachability check and Request for Payment support, wire irrevocability) and reachability checks via the Routing Numbers API. Community evidence corroborates that Increase's API directly exposes rail-level mechanics rather than a leaky abstraction. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation specifically of FedNow receipt/origination in production (only docs-level detail).
